subject.why: The subject is clearly a bunch of ripe yellow bananas with the requested green leaf tucked into the stem.

category.why: The banana bunch floats in the air at a dynamic three-quarter tilt over a vibrant blue sunburst pattern with no ground or floor.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, logos, watermarks, frames, or characters present.

framing.why: The bunch is well-centered with ample, balanced breathing room on all sides and nothing cropped.

colour.why: The palette is bright, juicy, and saturated, with warm yellow bananas creating high contrast against the vivid blue background.

detail.why: The forms are simple and clean without distracting micro-textures, scratches, or excessive surface detail.

style.why: The rendering matches the references with smooth, chunky 3D volumes, a soft satin sheen, and no outlines.
